clauses.scope_note: CLA §13(j): Feedback means ideas, suggestions, documents, or proposals Client submits to Cohere regarding Cohere Products. Permission concerns that Feedback, not other Client materials.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_submits_feedback means Client has submitted material meeting the agreement’s definition of Feedback.

clauses.scope_note: CLA §13(j): Cohere may commercialize submitted Feedback for any purpose; this permission is limited to Feedback as defined in the paragraph.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_submits_feedback means Client has submitted material meeting the agreement’s definition of Feedback.

clauses.scope_note: CLA §13(j): Cohere may disclose submitted Feedback to anyone worldwide. No separate notice or compensation condition is stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_submits_feedback means Client has submitted material meeting the agreement’s definition of Feedback.

clauses.scope_note: North Product Terms §2(a)(i): Client may permit limited access to and use of a copy of North hosted in the Client Environment, only to the extent required for Clients to use North functionality, and subject to the other CLA terms, including §3. This is a narrow schedule-specific permission, notwithstanding the main terms’ use restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: access_limited_to_functionality_use_by_clients means access is limited to what is required to permit Clients to use North’s functionality; the permission remains subject to the other CLA terms, including Client responsibilities.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 2(b)(ii): permits access to one instance of the Cohere Models specified by Cohere, and Compass, only as needed to support North.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_solely_to_support_north means use is only to the extent necessary to support North.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 2(b): standalone Cohere Model use from North is excluded unless expressly included in the applicable Order Form.
clauses.condition_explanation: expressly_included_in_order_form means the applicable Order Form expressly provides for standalone Cohere Model use from North.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Cohere Models on a standalone basis from North.
obligation_items.object: Cohere Models used standalone from North
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the applicable Order Form does not expressly provide for that standalone use.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 3(a)(i): North may only be installed or hosted in a qualifying Client Environment; Client must implement Cohere-provided technical prerequisites before installation.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_environment_meets_cohere_minimum_requirements means the Client Environment satisfies the minimum requirements provided to Client by Cohere. technical_prerequisites_implemented_before_installation means prerequisites Cohere provided to Client have been implemented before North is installed.

obligation_items.content: Implement Cohere-provided technical prerequisites before installing North.
obligation_items.object: Technical prerequisites for North installation provided by Cohere

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 3(a)(ii): using North with a non-Cohere large language model removes Cohere’s indemnification obligations for that use; this is an indemnity limitation, not a use permission or restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_north_with_non_cohere_large_language_model means Client uses North with a large language model other than Cohere Models. The text specifies the indemnity consequence only.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 4(a): describes an option to enable North Tools so North Users can access and query organizational data in external sources from within North; it does not itself state a distinct license grant or behavioral duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: north_tool_enabled_for_access_to_external_organizational_data means Client enables a North Tool for North Users to access or query organizational data in external sources.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 4(b): portions of North Tools supplied by a Third-Party Product owner and outside Cohere’s control are treated as Third-Party Products; Client selects North Tools and is responsible for managing and configuring access controls in Third-Party Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: client_enables_north_tool_with_third_party_component means Client chooses to enable a North Tool containing a third-party portion outside Cohere’s control. third_party_access_controls_managed_and_configured means Client manages and configures access controls in the relevant Third-Party Products.

obligation_items.content: Determine which North Tools to enable and manage and configure access controls in Third-Party Products.
obligation_items.object: North Tools selected for enablement and access controls in Third-Party Products
obligation_items.trigger: When North Tools are available for Client to enable or use, including tools with third-party portions outside Cohere’s control.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 4(c): defines Client Owned North Tools and states they are owned by Client for Agreement purposes if their development is expressly identified in the applicable Order Form or Scope of Work. This is an ownership allocation, not a grant of a listed activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: order_form_or_scope_of_work_expressly_identifies_development_of_client_owned_north_tools means the applicable Order Form or Scope of Work expressly identifies development of such tools. Client Owned North Tools are tools developed by Cohere or Client, designed to connect North with external applications or services, and unique and proprietary to Client.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 5(a): for North licensed by user count, included use is limited to the Order Form entitlement; excess users are charged at the Order Form’s per-user fee. A removed user count decreases only 90 days after the associated account is fully decommissioned, as demonstrated by Client’s written records.
clauses.condition_explanation: north_user_entitlement_exceeded means North is used for more users than the number specified in the North User entitlement. applicable_order_form_north_incremental_user_fee_paid means the applicable Order Form’s incremental user fee is paid. A removed North User does not reduce the count until 90 days after full account decommissioning demonstrated by Client’s written records.

obligation_items.content: Pay the North Incremental User Fee at the per-North-User rate set out in the applicable Order Form for use exceeding the North User entitlement.
obligation_items.object: North Incremental User Fee for North Users exceeding the Order Form entitlement
obligation_items.trigger: When North is licensed by a defined number of North Users and use exceeds that entitlement; removal reduces the count only 90 days after associated account decommissioning is fully completed and demonstrated by Client’s written records.

clauses.scope_note: North Partner Terms, Section 5(b): where North is licensed by TPM, exceeding the licensed TPM amount at any time during the Order Form term makes a fee immediately due to Partner for the remainder of that term, at Order Form pricing. Purchases must cover the maximum TPM reached at any time.
clauses.condition_explanation: tpm_exceeds_order_form_entitlement_at_any_time_during_term means processed TPM exceeds the license entitlement at any time during the Order Form term, as may be evidenced in a Usage Report. incremental_usage_purchased_to_cover_maximum_tpm means incremental usage is purchased to cover the maximum TPM reached during the term.

obligation_items.content: Pay Partner the immediately due incremental-usage fee for the remainder of the Order Form term, based on Order Form pricing, and purchase incremental usage covering the maximum TPM reached.
obligation_items.object: Incremental TPM usage fees payable to Partner
obligation_items.trigger: When processed TPM exceeds the license entitlement at any time during the Order Form term; the required purchase covers the maximum TPM reached at any time.

clauses.scope_note: Commercial SaaS Agreement, acceptance paragraph: use signifies acceptance and agreement to comply with the Agreement as amended under Section 14(l); a Customer that does not accept and agree must immediately cease further use. Includes representations concerning capacity and authority when acting for another person.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_accepts_and_agrees_to_comply_with_agreement means Customer accepts the Agreement and agrees to be bound by and comply with its terms. This clause does not encode the separate capacity and authority representations as activity constraints.

obligation_items.content: Immediately cease any further use of the Cohere API SaaS Services.
obligation_items.trigger: If Customer does not accept and agree to be bound by the Agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Commercial SaaS Agreement: access to the Cohere API SaaS Services is prohibited for monitoring availability, performance, or functionality, or for any benchmarking or competitive purpose.
clauses.condition_explanation: access_for_monitoring_or_benchmarking_or_competitive_purpose means access for monitoring service availability, performance, or functionality, or for any benchmarking or competitive purpose.

obligation_items.content: Do not access the Cohere API SaaS Services for monitoring availability, performance, or functionality, or for benchmarking or competitive purposes.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the purpose of access is monitoring availability, performance, or functionality, or benchmarking or competitive activity.

clauses.scope_note: Commercial SaaS Agreement: direct competitors may not access the Cohere API SaaS Services unless Cohere gives prior written consent.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_is_cohere_direct_competitor means Customer is a direct competitor of Cohere. cohere_prior_written_consent means Cohere has given prior written consent to that competitor’s access.

obligation_items.content: Do not access the Cohere API SaaS Services.
obligation_items.actor: Customer that is a direct competitor of Cohere
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Cohere has given prior written consent.
